svg.title: IPA vowel quadrilateral coordinate comparison
svg.desc: Same-scale comparison of phase 1 SVG, the official Japanese IPA chart PDF, and the updated SVG. The overlay compares seven source rules and eleven dots, before browser-specific glyph clearances.
svg.text: Same scale, aligned at the upper-left end of the front diagonal
Seven rules and eleven dot outlines. Browser-rendered line gaps follow the selected font.
